summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held September 24, 2026. Shareholders approved re-election of Brandon Van Buren and Ryusuke Utsumi as Class II directors (terms to the 2029 annual meeting), CEO Shiven Ramji's compensation package, the officer/director compensation policy, and re-appointment of Kost Forer Gabbay Kasierer (Ernst & Young Global member) as independent auditors for fiscal 2026, with board authority over remuneration. Roughly 204,331,510 ordinary shares, about 80.9% of shares outstanding on the record date, were present or represented. This is a routine meeting-results notice, not a special situation; the referenced proxy statement was furnished August 18, 2026.
